purpose: Bounded pretrained Q/K/V operator fidelity check of spatial complement moment refinements; not a generation-quality experiment or new-method claim
preconditions: Complete and independently inspect equal-cell PISA substitution test and spatial-prefix bookkeeping/cost test.
Freeze collection source/model/input/query/layer/head protocol before any GPU execution.
Review actual cost and scientific distinction; do not submit merely because instrumentation is ready.
inputs: Accepted CR18 original artificial sigma0.5 input and original gain vector for prompts0/1, with archived model/conditioning/source provenance; no shifted arm and no fresh64. This collects previously unsaved internal tensors at existing diagnostic inputs, not a new natural trajectory.
forward_order: Identical input/gain forward with capture only; bytewise output equality required

capture.query_representation: Actual BF16 Q multiplied by BF16 gains, after normalization and RoPE; preserve original gained_attention arithmetic
capture.keys_values: All actual text and image K after gained BF16 multiplication, and original BF16 V, for the two selected heads; text first, image raster order
capture.reference_outputs: Corresponding actual SDPA attention outputs for selected query/head pairs
capture.stored_tensors: Selected Q, all K/V for selected heads, selected SDPA outputs, explicit token indices, shape/dtype/hash receipts. Approximately400MB total for2prompts/3blocks/2heads; scratch bulk.
capture.guard: Observe exactly57 outer and inner attention calls during capture only; baseline remains unwrapped. Inspect actual SDPA arguments and returned tensors, not reconstructed multiplication. Same gains across calls; restore both wrappers in finally. Reject masks, scale changes or unexpected geometry.

offline_analysis_proposal.reference: CPUFP64 dense attention on saved BF16 consumed tensors, with1/sqrt128 scaling; separately report difference from actual BF16 SDPA outputs.
offline_analysis_proposal.cell_geometry: 16x16image-token cells on256x256grid. For each sampled query, exact image cells within Chebyshev radius2 of its containing cell, clipped atboundary; text keys always exact. No partial cells or register selection in this first PISA-isolation check.
controls: Exact sparse plus cell-centroid zeroth-order complement
True complementary-cell mean H with same mass/zero-order terms
offline_analysis_proposal.metrics: Every prompt/block/head/query absolute and dense-relative output error; logmass error, exact-support mass error, nonfinite values, coordinatewise value-range violations (necessary condition only, not a full convex-hull membership test). No selected winner. Rank8 remains unrun and is excluded from this collection analysis.
offline_analysis_proposal.boundaries: PISA-style equations only, not official fused-kernel reproduction; lower operator error is not image-quality gain or speed.

gpu_budget_proposal.status: No job submitted; SU check and frozen review required before submission.

preservation: CR14-18 sources/protocols/results and fresh64 unchanged; distinct collection directory and watcher registration if submitted.
